title: Undergraduate Syllabus v4
source: Derived from the finished IT 204 Computer Programming 2 syllabus (IT204-Programming2-EOMS-1.pdf), src/views/builder2/FormPaper.jsx (the layout and tag conventions the form prints), src/lib/syllabusModel.js (the rules the builder already enforces) and the admin catalog. docs/reference/ has no template PDF. The sample states no scores, so every value listed in `assumptions` and every rule with a `note` is a project decision for the curriculum office to confirm.
assumptions: rules[].severity (except where a note says the builder already blocks it)

insufficient.note: Fewer than this many of the faculty-written sections having anything in them is reported as 'not enough content', never as a low score.

rules.message: Course code (I) is empty.
rules.fix: Enter the course code

rules.message: Course title (II) is empty.
rules.fix: Enter the course title

rules.message: Program is empty.
rules.fix: Choose the program

rules.message: Course description (III) is empty.
rules.fix: Write the course description

rules.message: Pre-requisite (IV) is empty.
rules.fix: Enter the pre-requisite

rules.message: Lecture and laboratory units (V) are not both entered.
rules.fix: Enter the lecture and laboratory units

rules.message: There are no course learning outcomes (VI).
rules.fix: Ask an administrator to add the course learning outcomes

rules.message: The Learning Plan (VII) has no lesson with a learning outcome (ILO).
rules.fix: Add a lesson with a learning outcome (ILO)

rules.message: The vision in this syllabus is not the school's current vision.
rules.fix: Resubmit so the syllabus carries the current vision
rules.note: A draft has no stored copy (it always shows the live text) and a submit stores the live text, so this fails only if the stored snapshot differs from the live catalog, for example when an admin edited it after the syllabus was submitted.

rules.message: The mission in this syllabus is not the school's current mission.
rules.fix: Resubmit so the syllabus carries the current mission

rules.message: The graduate attributes (EGAs) in this syllabus are not the program's current ones.
rules.fix: Resubmit so the syllabus carries the current graduate attributes

rules.message: The program outcomes (POs) in this syllabus are not the program's current ones.
rules.fix: Resubmit so the syllabus carries the current program outcomes

rules.message: {where} has no CLO tag.
rules.fix: Tag every ILO with the CLO it builds

rules.message: {where} has a tag that no longer resolves: {tag}.
rules.fix: Fix the outcome tags that no longer resolve

rules.message: Learning Plan row {row} is missing the column: {missing}.
rules.fix: Complete the Learning Plan columns

rules.message: {where} has nothing in: {missing}.
rules.fix: Fill in the empty Learning Plan columns
rules.note: The builder only advises about empty columns, so this is major, not blocking.

rules.message: {where} has an empty ILO before a filled one, so the printed numbering has a gap.
rules.fix: Remove the empty ILO between filled ones
rules.note: ILO numbers are generated by position (ILO1, ILO2, ...), so the only way to break the numbering is an empty ILO between filled ones.

rules.message: Learning Plan row {row} comes before an earlier week.
rules.fix: Put the Learning Plan rows in week order
rules.note: Added: rows printed out of week order. The builder allows any order.

rules.message: Course requirements (VIII): {have} listed, at least {need} needed.
rules.fix: List at least three course requirements

rules.message: Requirement "{text}" starts with its own number; the form numbers the list for you.
rules.fix: Remove the typed numbers from the requirements

rules.message: References ({letter}. {title}) has no entries and is not marked not applicable.
rules.fix: Fill in each reference group or mark it not applicable

rules.message: References ({letter}. {title}) is marked not applicable but has entries.
rules.fix: Resolve the reference group marked not applicable that has entries

rules.message: The Grading System (X) has no components.
rules.fix: Add the grading components

rules.message: The grading components total {total}%, not {need}%.
rules.fix: Make the grading components total 100%

rules.message: The override formulas cannot be empty.
rules.fix: Fill in the override formulas or switch them off

rules.message: The {which} formula does not mention {missing}.
rules.fix: Make the grading formulas name every component and exam term
rules.note: The Term Grade formula must list every grading component with its percentage; the Final Rating formula must name every examination term.

rules.message: The sign-off block is not as the form requires: {problem}.
rules.fix: Check the sign-off block
rules.note: UNSURE. The preparer comes from the owner's account and the other two roles are added by the system, so this can only fail when the stored sign-off holds names a faculty member should not enter.

rules.message: The course description is {words} {nouns}; about {need} are expected.
rules.fix: Expand the course description

rules.message: {where} is only {words} {nouns}; an ILO states what the student will do.
rules.fix: Write fuller learning outcomes (ILOs)

rules.message: CLO {n} has no {missing}.
rules.fix: Ask an administrator to complete the CLO titles and statements

rules.message: There are {have} references; at least {need} are expected.
rules.fix: Add more references

rules.message: CLO {n} is not tagged with a valid graduate attribute (EGA).
rules.fix: Ask an administrator to tag each CLO with graduate attributes
rules.note: Admin-managed data; the builder already holds faculty at step 2 for this.

rules.message: CLO {n} is not tagged with a valid program outcome (PO).
rules.fix: Ask an administrator to tag each CLO with program outcomes
rules.note: Admin-managed data; the builder already holds faculty at step 2 for this.

rules.message: CLO {n} is tagged PO {po}, which maps to EGA {ega}, but EGA {ega} is not tagged.
rules.fix: Ask an administrator to tag the EGAs the POs imply

rules.message: CLO {n}'s tags would not print as {format}: numbers must be unique and in order.
rules.fix: Ask an administrator to put the CLO tags in order

rules.message: CLO {n} is not built by any ILO in the Learning Plan.
rules.fix: Cover every course outcome in the Learning Plan

rules.message: {where} has no assessment task.
rules.fix: Add an assessment task to every lesson

rules.message: CLO {n} is not assessed: no week that builds it has an assessment task.
rules.fix: Assess every course learning outcome

rules.message: There is no {term} examination row in the Learning Plan.
rules.fix: Add the missing examination rows

rules.message: The grading system has no examination component.
rules.fix: Include an examination in the grading system

rules.message: The credit units are not usable: lecture {lecture}, laboratory {lab}.
rules.fix: Correct the credit units

rules.message: The plan covers {planned} of {expected} weeks{hours}.
rules.fix: Plan the full term

rules.message: Row {row} has a week that is not within 1 to {to}: "{week}".
rules.fix: Fix the weeks outside the term

rules.message: Week{s} {weeks} appear{verb} in more than one row.
rules.fix: Resolve the weeks used by more than one row

rules.message: There are no references.
rules.fix: Add references

rules.message: A reference has no year: "{text}".
rules.fix: Add the year to each reference

rules.message: A reference is {age} years old ({year}); the limit is {limit}: "{text}".
rules.fix: Replace the outdated references
rules.note: Age is measured from the school year the syllabus belongs to, never from today's date.
